title: 听力挑战 · 天气预报讨论

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: Have you seen the weather forecast for today?
rounds.lineCn: 你看过今天的天气预报了吗?

grammar.name: will 表将来预测
grammar.note: will + 动词原形表示对将来天气的预测。

options.text: Yes, it will rain in the afternoon.
options.feedback: will rain 表达对下午天气的预测,回应问句。
过去时谈的是昨天,不是今天的预报。

options.text: Yes, it is raining right now.
options.feedback: 现在进行时是当下实况,不是预报内容。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: Do you think we should bring umbrellas outside?
rounds.lineCn: 你觉得我们出门该带伞吗?

grammar.name: be going to 表预测
grammar.note: be going to 根据现有迹象做出对将来的预测。

options.text: Yes, it is going to get windy later.
options.feedback: is going to 根据迹象预测天气变化,回应贴切。

options.text: Yes, it got windy last night.
options.feedback: 过去时谈昨晚,不能支持带伞的建议。
谈的是午饭,与天气无关。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: What will the weather be like this weekend?

grammar.name: will 与 be going to 互换
grammar.note: 预测天气时 will 和 be going to 均可表示将来的情况。

options.text: It is going to be sunny and warm.
options.feedback: be going to 预测周末天气,回答自然。

options.text: It was cold and dry last week.
options.feedback: 过去时说的是上周,不是周末预报。

options.text: It becomes rainy in the south.
options.feedback: 一般现在时谈南方常态,与周末无关。
